description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class 'BatchApiResource' for handling batch requests in the Apache Fineract project. It provides endpoints for processing batch operations, including validation and transaction management, and integrates with various Fineract services and security components.

classes.name: BatchApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class for batch request handling in Fineract, supporting batch processing with transaction control and validation.

methods.name: handleBatchRequests
methods.description: Handles POST requests for batch processing, executing batch requests with optional enclosing transaction, after security validation.

methods.name: validateRequestMethodsAllowedOnInstanceType
methods.description: Validates that batch request methods are permitted based on the current instance mode (e.g., read-only).
